title: Return Timing Schedule for Finch Note Reinstatements
content:
**Schedule.** For a Finch Note reinstated on returned merchandise in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the reinstatement return-timing share is 0.90 when the return was authorized more than 30 calendar days after the unit was completed, 0.95 when it was authorized more than 14 and up to 30 days after, and 1 otherwise.

The day the unit was completed is the completed date on its purchase record, and the day the return was authorized is the creation date of the return request for that purchase record, both under Merchandise Purchases.

| Calendar days from completion to the return authorization | Reinstatement return-timing share |
|---|---|
| 31 or more | 0.90 |
| 15 to 30 | 0.95 |
| 14 or fewer | 1 |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical)

Unit completed on 1 March: a return authorized on 15 March (14 days) gives 1; on 16 March (15 days) 0.95; on 31 March (30 days) 0.95; on 1 April (31 days) 0.90.
